__data__.text: Project Overview Iâve developed a "digital twin" RAG chatbot that answers portfolio queries using a FAISS index optimized for retrieving full content blocks rather than fragments. The pipeline ensures conversational continuity by rewriting multi-turn prompts into standalone questions and maintains high reliability through an LLM-as-judge evaluator that triggers bounded self-correction to prevent hallucinations. To stay current, the system automatically re-indexes my website daily, ensuring all responses are grounded in my latest professional data. https://huggingface.co/spaces/ritup3/PersonaRag

__data__.text: Research Experience Developed a real-time deep learningâbased computer vision system for object detection, localization, and pose estimation in autonomous robotic applications. The proposed approach enables accurate grasping of cuboid and cylindrical objects without requiring prior 3D models, improving flexibility and reducing computational cost. Implemented the system on an industrial robotic setup with conveyor integration and dual grippers, achieving up to 89%+ detection precision and 100% grasping success in experiments, demonstrating effectiveness for smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0 environments. Co-authored an ACL submission introducing SPORTABSET, a diagnostic benchmark for long-context text-to-table generation from unstructured narratives. The work focuses on evaluating how well large language models maintain evolving multi-entity state across extended contexts by leveraging complementary domains (cricket and basketball) that require both multi-table coordination and wide-table aggregation. Conducted systematic evaluations of state-of-the-art LLMs using multiple prompting and decomposition strategies, and developed robustness analyses through perturbations such as entity substitution, anonymization, and entity entanglement to probe model reliance on surface cues versus true contextual reasoning.
